crossRefs.note: Tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “In the day when I chose Israel, and swore to the offspring of the house of Jacob…
Moreover also I swore to them in the wilderness, that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them…
For I lift up my hand to heaven and declare, as I live forever,
The angel whom I saw standing on the sea and on the land lifted up his right hand to the sky,
and swore by him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and the things that are in it, the earth and the things…
Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
behold, I will send and take all the families of the north,” says Yahweh, “and I will send to Nebuchadnezzar the king…
For Yahweh, the God of Israel, says to me: “Take this cup of the wine of wrath from my hand, and cause all the nations…
Yahweh’s word that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the Philistines, before Pharaoh struck Gaza.
The words of Amos, who was among the herdsmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of…
Gather yourselves together, yes, gather together, you nation that has no shame,

translations.web: Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “I have sworn, ‘Surely the nations that are around you will bear their shame.’
translations.bsb: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: I have sworn with an uplifted hand that surely the nations around you will endure reproach of their own.
translations.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; I have lifted up mine hand, Surely the heathen that are about you, they shall bear their shame.
translations.asv: therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I have sworn, saying, Surely the nations that are round about you, they shall bear their shame.
